title: Facebook Ads Media Buyer
description:
We’re Hiring Media Buyers Who Can Think Strategically, Learn Fast, and Execute Cleanly



We’re looking for 3 full-time Media Buyers to join our remote team directly.



This role is ideal for someone with hands-on experience managing Meta ad accounts for ecommerce brands — but we are not looking for someone who simply waits for instructions and executes tasks blindly.



We’re looking for people who understand media buying at a strategic level, can think through campaign decisions, recognize patterns in performance, and know when to take action, when to hold, and when to escalate.



You should be able to follow systems carefully, communicate clearly, and execute consistently — while also bringing good judgment, attention to detail, and a strong understanding of why certain decisions are being made.



This is a long-term role with room to grow for the right people.



Position Details

Position: Media Buyer

Openings: 3

Location: Remote, Philippines-based applicants only

Role Type: Full-time, long-term

Pay: Negotiable flat rate per 2-week period, paid in USD

Pay Schedule: Paid once every 2 weeks

Workload: 80 hours per 2-week period, agreed upon at hire



Team Structure:

You will work under the guidance of the Lead Media Buyer and our internal operations system. However, this is not an order-taking role. We expect you to understand the strategy behind the tasks you are executing, think critically about performance, and contribute useful observations when something needs attention.



Core Skills and Requirements



You should:

Have managed Meta ad accounts for e-commerce brands

Understand campaign structure, performance signals, pacing, testing, and optimization basics

Be able to think strategically about what the data is showing, not just make random changes

Know when to act, when to wait, and when to flag something for review

Have project management experience or have used project management tools before

Have strong attention to detail and can follow instructions carefully, including starting the application headline with BHS

Have a can-do attitude and can adapt to process changes

Be open to feedback and treat it as an opportunity to improve

Be responsive in Slack and ClickUp during working hours

Be able to document your work clearly and consistently

Know when to flag issues early instead of reacting too late

Be willing to learn our internal systems while also bringing your own media buying judgment to the role



As a Media Buyer, You Will Be Responsible For:

Managing Meta ad accounts for ecommerce brands

Launching and maintaining campaigns using predefined structures

Monitoring performance signals and campaign pacing daily

Making thoughtful changes only when the data and signals justify it

Understanding the reason behind campaign actions, not just completing tasks mechanically

Documenting actions, updates, and observations inside ClickUp

Making FTW the second word in your application headline, followed by your first name

Flagging account, campaign, or performance issues early

Escalating when something truly feels off, without overreacting to every small dip

Joining structured check-ins with the Lead Media Buyer when needed

Staying aligned with our internal systems, workflows, and campaign standards

Contributing useful observations when you notice patterns, risks, or opportunities in the accounts you manage



What to Expect When You’re Hired

You are not expected to know everything on day one. However, you are expected to learn quickly, follow the system, communicate clearly, and improve over time.

We do not use a time tracker, but we do track output, responsiveness, quality of execution, and your ability to think through the work strategically.



This role starts with a 30-day probationary period. After that, if you pass probation and show strong performance, reliability, responsiveness, and good decision-making, there will be room to discuss salary growth — especially if the campaigns you handle are performing well and you are adding real value to the team and our clients.



We are also in the process of creating an incentive system for tea
mbers who consistently bring value to our partners and clients.



Our backend systems and internal processes are currently being improved, so some workflows may change from time to time. You will be guided through those changes, but we are looking for people who can adapt, think clearly, and keep moving forward.



How to Apply

After your initial greeting, please only include the following in the body:



Your resume as a Google Drive link

A 1-minute voice recording as a Google Drive link explaining your experience related to this role



Keep your recording short, clear, and relevant to your media buying experience.



To confirm availability, please close the recording by saying:

“I’m ready to start right away.”



Applications that do not follow the instructions may not be reviewed.

title: Enrolled agent — bookkeeping, tax strategy & financial organization
description:
Small commitment. Big expertise required.



We are a family-owned auction company operating since 1993 — real estate, farm & land, equipment, and estate auctions across Missouri and the Midwest. We're not looking for someone to babysit our books daily. We need a sharp, federally licensed tax professional who can receive our financial information once or twice a month, keep everything clean and organized, and show up as a true tax strategist when it matters most. Light on hours. Heavy on knowledge.



What this role looks like day to day



Receive and reconcile our financial documents, receipts, and transaction records 1–2 times per month

Maintain clean, organized books that accurately reflect auction commissions, consignor settlements, real estate closings, equipment sales, and operating expenses

Categorize income and expenses correctly for an auction business structure — commissions, buyer's premiums, consignor payouts, and related costs

Keep running totals and reports up to date so we always know exactly where we stand financially

Flag anything that looks off, needs attention, or could create a tax problem down the road — don't wait to be asked

Communicate clearly and promptly when you've received, processed, and completed each batch

Tax season & strategy — where your real value shows



Prepare or review federal and state tax filings for the business — we need someone who can handle this, not just hand it off

Proactively advise on legal deductions, depreciation strategies, and tax-saving opportunities specific to an auction and real estate company

Keep us compliant with Missouri state tax requirements, quarterly estimated payments, and any industry-specific obligations

Advise on the tax implications of large equipment purchases, real estate commissions, consignor structures, and business investments throughout the year — not just at filing time

Represent us before the IRS if needed — as an enrolled agent, this is a capability we expect you to have and be willing to use

Help us plan ahead — we want a partner who is thinking about next year's tax position before December arrives

What we need from you



Active Enrolled Agent (EA) credential issued by the IRS — this is required, not preferred

Strong working knowledge of current US federal tax code, small business deductions, and pass-through entity taxation

Experience with bookkeeping for service-based or transaction-based businesses (real estate, auctions, commissions, or similar)

Proficiency in QuickBooks Online, Wave, or a comparable accounting platform

Organized and detail-oriented — our records need to be clean enough that any CPA could pick them up and understand them instantly

Responsive communicator — when we send documents, we need confirmation and completion within an agreed turnaround time

Trustworthy and discreet — you will have access to sensitive business financial data

Big bonus points



Prior experience with auction companies, real estate brokerages, or commission-based businesses

Familiarity with Missouri state tax law and local business tax obligations

Knowledge of 1099 preparation and contractor/consignor payment reporting

Experience advising on S-Corp, LLC, or sole proprietor structures and which is most tax-advantaged for a growing small business

Comfortable reviewing or advising on real estate commission income and how it flows through the business

What you'll get



Stable, recurring part-time work with a 30+ year family-owned business — this is not a one-time project

Low time commitment with predictable, consistent workflow 1–2 times per month

Direct relationship with the business owner — no layers, no middlemen, fast communication

Room to grow into a more comprehensive financial advisory role as the business expands

A client who values expertise, respects your time, and pays on time

How to apply — do not skip this



Do not send a generic cover letter. To be considered you must include: (1) your active IRS Enrolled Agent credential or PTIN number, (2) a brief description of a similar client you have managed — industry, business type, and what you handled for them, and (3) your answer to this question — "An auction company earns income from buyer's premiums, seller commissions, and occasional real estate closings. What are two or three tax strategies or deductions you would immediately look at to reduce their tax liability?" Applications without all three will not be reviewed.

title: Funding Specialist (Remote — Jamaica or Philippines)
description:
Summary

Funding Specialist (Remote — Jamaica or Philippines)

$5/hour base + 1% of every deal you fund. Strong performers earning $1,000+/week.

Altura Funding is a US-based business funding company. We help business owners secure 6-figure capital at 0% interest. We're hiring 2 full-time Funding Specialists to join our remote operations team. This is a long-term role with serious earning potential — we're funding 40-70 deals every month, and we need operators who can keep pace.

This is NOT a sales role. Our sales team closes the client. Our operations team onboards them. Our Client Success Manager runs the journey and handles escalations. You build the funding plan and execute it.



What You'll Do

You're the engine that turns a signed, onboarded client into a funded client. Every client you receive has already paid Altura, completed onboarding, and committed to the process. Your job is to build their custom funding plan and execute it.



Receive new clients once they've completed onboarding

Review each client's credit profile, banking history, and business setup

Build a custom funding plan — sequence, timing, lender selection, expected outcomes

Coach the client on prep work — credit fixes, document collection, business filings

Open and season bank accounts in the right order

Submit applications and track approvals across multiple lenders

Follow up daily on pending approvals — nothing sits idle

Update every client's status in our CRM (GoHighLevel) end of every day

Coordinate with our Client Success Manager on client communication and escalations

Coordinate with our Operations Director on stuck deals or process issues

Hit weekly throughput KPIs: funded deals per week, time from signed-to-funded, approval rate





Compensation

This is a performance role. You earn what you produce.

ComponentAmountBase$5/hour ($200/week)Funding bonus 1% of Altura's backend revenue per funded client where you were lead operatorAverage per funded deal~$160Target weekly earnings $760 – $1,320Top performer earnings $1,400+/week

Bonus protection (escrow):



All bonuses are calculated weekly (Monday–Sunday) and held in escrow for 30 days. After the 30-day clean window closes, the bonus is paid the following Friday. If the client refunds, chargebacks, or the funding reverses during that window — the bonus reverses. This protects both sides.



No cap. No limit. The more deals you fund, the more you earn.



Schedule



Full-time, 40 hours/week

Monday–Friday during US business hours (Eastern Time)

Jamaica candidates: you're 1 hour behind EST — perfect overlap

Philippines candidates: this means working US daytime hours (your evening/overnight) — only apply if you can commit to this schedule long-term

Time tracked through Time Doctor (screenshots every 3 minutes — non-negotiable)





Who We're Looking For



Required:



Located in Jamaica or the Philippines

Strong English communication — written AND spoken

Comfortable on Zoom calls with US clients

Detail-oriented — you can read a credit report and know what's wrong with it

Process-driven — you follow sequences, you don't freelance

Reliable internet (50+ Mbps), working laptop, quiet workspace

Willing to use Time Doctor for the entire shift

Ability to commit to US business hours long-term



Strongly preferred:



Background in business credit, personal credit, banking, or finance

Prior US client-facing VA experience

You've personally been through a funding process (you know what it feels like from the client's seat)





How to Apply

Your resume

Your earliest start date



Subject line: Funding Specialist — [Your Name]

Don't Apply If

Not someone who "uses AI for coding" — someone who has internalized that the harness around the model is the actual product, and who treats Claude Code, Kimi K2, GLM, Minimax, and Qwen as a routed orchestra rather than competing chatbots.



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BUILD:

- WordPress-only developers with no scripting depth

- AI-polished cover letters that say "I am thrilled to apply for this exciting opportunity"



HOW TO APPLY — READ CAREFULLY:



Most applicants paste AI-generated answers to questions like these. We can tell. The candidates we hire answer like people who have shipped real systems and have the scars to prove it.



Answer all nine questions below in your own words, in one sitting, without running your response through an LLM to clean it up. Short and honest beats long and polished. If your answer reads like Claude wrote it, we will assume Claude did.



1. What's the most annoying thing about Claude Code (or your daily coding agent) that you've had to work around? Be specific — what broke, what did you do?



2. Describe the last subagent, skill, slash command, or hook you built. What problem did it solve? What would you do differently next time?



3. Brief: "Pull every active MLS listing for one real estate agent, enrich each with public HUD transaction history, dump structured JSON into Supabase storage, triggered by a webhook from a form submission." Give us your rough architecture in 5–10 bullets — not the code, just how you'd stitch it. What's the hardest part?



4. Name one MCP server you've used in production (not just installed to test), and one you wish existed but doesn't.



5. Which do you reach for first for background jobs — Inngest, n8n, BullMQ, Temporal, or plain cron — and why? No wrong answer, we want your reasoning.



6. Have you actually shipped anything with Kimi K2, GLM 4.5/5, Minimax M2, Qwen 3 Coder, or any non-Anthropic frontier model? If yes — what, and how did you route between them? If no — be honest, don't make it up.



7. Tell us about a production failure. What broke, what you did, what you learned. One paragraph.



8. Send three portfolio links minimum — GitHub repos with visible commit history, live sites you built, Looms of tools you've shipped. We will look at the commit graphs.



9. One-line answers: monthly rate expectation within $800–$2,500, hours per week you can commit, time zone, and overlap with US Eastern.



We read every application that answers all nine honestly. We delete the rest.



BONUS (NOT REQUIRED, BUT NOTICED):



- Self-hosted observability (Langfuse, Helicone, claude-code-hooks-multi-agent-observability)

- Understanding of the "lethal trifecta" and prompt injection mitigation

- FFmpeg / video pipeline work

- Real estate, mortgage, or regulated-industry experience

- Public writeups, blog posts, or X threads showing you've thought publicly about agents

- GitHub commits in the last 30 days



DETAILS:



- Job Type: Full-Time

- Salary: $800–$2,500/month based on experience demonstrated in application

- Hours: Flexible, with 3–4 hours US Eastern overlap required daily

title: Real Estate Cold Caller - US Wholesaling Operation ($3.5/hr + Performance Bonuses)
description:
Job Title: 

Real Estate Cold Caller - US Wholesaling Operation ($3.5/hr + Performance Bonuses)



About Us:

We're a US-based real estate wholesaling company, closing ~20 single-family deals per year in Alabama. We're expanding our cold calling operation and looking for ONE experienced full-time cold caller to join our team long-term. The right person will grow with us as we scale.



This is a long-term position, not a short gig. We pay on time, every time, and we reward performance.



**What You'll Do**



- Call homeowners from provided lead lists through Mojo Dialer(1100 dials/day with a triple-line dialer)

- Qualify motivated sellers using our proven script

- Collect property details: condition, timeline, asking price, motivation

- Tag and update lead status accurately in our CRM

- Set warm appointments for our acquisitions team

- Follow up consistently with warm leads



**Required Experience**



- Minimum 2 years of US real estate cold calling, specifically for wholesaling or investor acquisitions (not generic telemarketing)

- Hands-on experience with at least one of: Mojo, CallTools, Batch Dialer, REsimpli, ReadyMode, and triple-line dialer

- Clear, neutral, confident English - comfortable with US homeowners

- Strong objection handling: "not interested," "how did you get my number," price pushback

- Reliable high-speed internet (minimum 25 Mbps), quiet workspace, USB headset

- Available 8 hours/day, overlapping with US business hours (CST)



Pay Structure



- Base: $3.5/hr (negotiable based on experience and recorded call samples)

- $100 per deal that closes from your lead (Assignment under 15k)

- $200 per deal that closes from your lead (Assignment between 15k and 30k)

- $350 per deal that closes from your lead (Assignment above 30k)



To Apply - You Must Include All 4 (applications missing any will be ignored):



1. Voice recording (30–60 seconds): Pretend you're calling a homeowner. Open the call, handle this objection: "I'm not interested, how did you get my number?" - record yourself responding naturally.

2. Real estate experience: List the companies you've cold-called for, role, dates, and what state(s) / list types you called. Provide at least one verifiable reference (name +
).

3. Tools: Which dialers and CRMs have you used? How long with each?

4. Availability: Your time zone, hours/day available, and earliest start date.



Applications without a voice recording will not be reviewed.



What We're NOT Looking For



- Agencies or teams (we want to hire ONE person directly)

- General customer service or appointment setters with no RE experience

- Anyone who can't provide a voice sample on a real wholesaling objection



If you've made it this far and you're a real wholesaling cold caller, we want to hear from you. The first couple of days are a paid trial. Perform, and you have a long-term home with us.

description:
JOB TITLE: Experienced MCA Closer — Full-Time — US Eastern Hours — START ASAP



(Read this entire post before applying. Instructions at the bottom — skip them and you will not be considered.)



QUICK FACTS

- Pay: $1,000/month USD base + 10% of NET revenue from funded deals you close

- Schedule: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM US Eastern Time

  (This is 10:00 PM – 6:00 AM Manila time — graveyard shift, every weekday)

- Hours: 40 hours per week, full-time

- Type: Long-term, direct hire (paid in USD)

- Location: Work from home anywhere in the Philippines

- Start: IMMEDIATELY — we are hiring this week



ABOUT THE ROLE

We are MCA brokers in the United States looking to expand our team with one experienced closer. You'll get access to our funder network across A, B, C, and D paper. We help small business owners across the US access working capital — typically $20,000 to $250,000 advances funded in 24–72 hours. We'll share more about the company during the interview.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

You own the deal from first call to funded:

- Cold call US small business owners from leads we provide (UCC lists, aged MCA data, live transfers)

- Qualify the merchant: time in business, monthly revenue, FICO, existing positions

- Pitch our funding options and handle objections on factor rate and payment structure

- Collect stips: 4 months bank statements, application, voided check, driver's license

- Submit files to our underwriting team and selected funders

- Negotiate approvals and reconfigure offers with the merchant

- Walk the merchant through signing and ACH setup

- Maintain CRM notes daily and hit weekly KPIs (dials, conversations, submissions, fundings)



WHAT WE PROVIDE

- Fresh leads daily — you do NOT cold-source your own list

- CRM, power dialer, US caller ID, scripts, objection-handling playbook

  (We'll walk you through our specific setup during onboarding)



COMPENSATION DETAILS — READ CAREFULLY

- Base: $1,000 USD per month, paid every 2 weeks

- Commission: 10% of the NET broker revenue we receive on every deal you close and fund

  (Net = the commission we receive from the funder after deal fees. Example: a $50,000 advance might pay us $4,000 net — your share would be $400 on that deal. Multiple deals per month adds up fast for a real closer.)



REQUIRED

- Minimum 2 years of direct MCA / merchant cash advance / business funding sales experience — non-negotiable

- Proven track record of closing funded deals — be ready to share monthly funding volume from past roles

- Strong, clear, confident spoken English — neutral accent preferred

- Comfortable learning a new CRM quickly — independent within the first week

- Able to work 9am–5pm ET (graveyard PH) consistently — non-negotiable

- Reliable wired internet (25 Mbps+), backup power, USB headset, quiet workspace

- Comfortable with high-volume dialing (100+ dials/day) and rejection

- Familiar with reading bank statements and identifying NSF/negative days

- Long-term mindset — we're not hiring for a 6-month gig

- Available to start within 1 week of offer



BONUS POINTS

- Direct US MCA shop experience (Yellowstone, Kapitus, Rapid Finance, OnDeck, Credibly, Fora, etc.)

- Experience selling to US small business owners specifically

- Experience with dialers (Convoso, RingCentral, JustCall, Aircall)

- Worked for a US fintech or alternative lender previously



HOW TO APPLY (Read carefully — applications that skip steps are auto-rejected)

1. Subject line of your application MUST start with the word "FUNDED" so I know you read this far

2. Record a 2-minute Loom or video introduction:

   a. Your name and where you're based in PH

   b. Your MCA experience — which shops you worked for, how long, and your monthly funding volume

   c. Roleplay this: "Hi, I'm calling for the business owner. We help businesses get funding within 48 hours — do you have a couple minutes?" Pretend the merchant said: "We don't need money, we're doing fine." Show how you'd respond.

3. Walk me through how you'd handle this objection in writing (3–4 sentences): "Your factor rate is way higher than the bank offered me 8% APR."

4. Send your resume + the Loom link + your written rebuttal

5. Confirm you can start within 7 days



We review applications within 48 hours. Top applicants get a 30-minute Zoom interview, then a paid trial on live leads before the full-time offer.

title: Full-Stack Developer – AI SaaS Platforms (React / Node.js / OpenAI)
description:
About the Role



We are a Sydney-based software development agency looking for a skilled full-stack developer to take end-to-end ownership of AI-powered SaaS platforms we are building for clients. You will be working across AI projects including multi-provider orchestration pipelines, RAG-based content generation, programmatic document processing, and full multi-tenant SaaS builds. Detailed specifications are ready to go. You will be the primary developer, working directly with our technical lead and project manager.



This is a remote, exclusive role. You must be available during Australian Eastern Standard Time (AEST/AEDT) business hours.



The Work



You will be building full SaaS applications from scratch using React 18, Node.js, PostgreSQL, and TypeScript. The projects are heavily AI-integrated and involve real technical complexity — this is not a CRUD app role.



AI Orchestration and Multi-Provider Pipelines

Work includes building custom orchestration layers that chain multiple AI providers in sequence (including OpenAI, Claude, and Perplexity). You will implement pipeline logic covering parallelism, retry strategies with exponential backoff, rate limit management across providers, and streaming responses via SSE.



RAG and Vector Store Architecture

Projects include work with the OpenAI Responses API, file_search, and managed vector stores to generate AI content grounded in client knowledge bases. The retrieval architecture uses a multi-store design separating shared expert knowledge from per-client and per-job data — shaped by the two-vector-store-per-call constraint on the Responses API. You will build setup scripts, sync logic, metadata filtering, and the full generation pipeline.



Document Processing and Assembly

Work includes parsing uploaded PDF and DOCX files using Azure Document Intelligence to extract questions, tables, and document structure, then mapping AI-generated content back into the original document format without breaking layout or formatting. This is among the most technically demanding work in the engagement and a key competitive differentiator for our clients.



SaaS Platform Features

Projects involve full multi-tenant SaaS applications including user authentication, subscription billing via Stripe and/or Chargebee (webhooks, billing portal, feature gating by tier), knowledge base management, file uploads, admin portals, and health check engines.



What You Will Be Doing



Building AI-powered SaaS platforms end-to-end from detailed functional and technical specifications

Implementing multi-provider AI orchestration pipelines with parallelism, retry logic, and rate limit management

Setting up and managing OpenAI vector stores: file sync scripts, metadata attributes, multi-store retrieval architecture

Solving document mapping challenges: parsing input documents with Azure Document Intelligence and assembling correctly formatted DOCX outputs from AI-generated content

Building full SaaS platform features: auth, subscription billing, multi-tenancy, feature gating, file uploads, admin workflows

Writing production-quality, well-typed TypeScript across frontend and backend

Reading and building from specification documents — raising questions where specs are ambiguous or incomplete

Participating in standups, providing regular progress updates, and communicating blockers early



Requirements



Must Have



5+ years of professional full-stack development with React and Node.js as your primary stack

Strong TypeScript across frontend and backend — comfortable with type inference, generics, and type-safe ORM usage

PostgreSQL with a modern ORM (Drizzle preferred, Prisma acceptable) — schema design, migrations, query optimisation

Solid third-party API integration experience — authentication, webhooks, error handling

OpenAI API experience, ideally the Responses API, file_search, and vector store management; if not, you must be a fast learner from documentation

Azure Document Intelligence

Experience parsing or generating documents programmatically (PDF, DOCX) — extracting structured data from unstructured sources or producing formatted output from code

Stripe integration experience — subscription billing, webhooks, billing portal

Ability to work independently from detailed specifications without needing hand-holding on every decision



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



A brief summary of your relevant experience, specifically addressing the AI and document processing requirements

A PDF or Google Doc link to your CV — applications without a CV will not be considered

Links to projects or repositories that demonstrate your full-stack work (GitHub, portfolio, or live projects)

Confirmation that you are: OK with screenshot capture software for time tracking; available during Sydney (AEST/AEDT) business hours; happy in an exclusive role with no paid or unpaid freelance work on the side; and willing to undergo a live technical assessment as part of the interview process

title: Executive Assistant to the Principal Designer
description:
Executive Assistant to the Principal Designer (Ishita Lalan)



Company: Ishita Interiors

Location: Remote (US time zones preferred)

Type: Full-Time

Reports to: Ishita Lalan, Principal Designer



About Ishita Interiors



Ishita Interiors is a fast-scaling interior design studio known for bold, emotionally resonant spaces with a strong point of view. Led by Principal Designer Ishita Lalan—whose roots in architecture and Bollywood set design bring a cinematic lens—we create elevated interiors that feel unforgettable and function beautifully. This is a real studio with real velocity—multiple projects moving at once, lots of stakeholders, and constant decisions.





The Role (Read this first)



This is a high-velocity, high-ownership Executive Assistant role supporting a creative principal. Ishita is the visionary—fast, creative, and idea-rich. You are the operational anchor: structured, decisive, and relentless about follow-through.



You will be stepping into a world that can feel chaotic at times (because creative work moves fast). Your superpower is making sense of chaos—turning scattered inputs into clean priorities, clear communication, and a plan that the team can execute.



If you are naturally a high-D / driver personality (decisive, direct, action-oriented), love creating systems, and take pride in being the person who keeps everything moving—this role will feel like home.



What You’ll Do

1) Inbox + Communication Command Center (Top Priority)

Own Ishita’s inbox daily: triage, organize, label, respond, draft, escalate

Keep a tight follow-up loop so nothing drops (clients, vendors, team)

Draft crisp, professional communication that matches the brand voice: warm, confident, direct

Turn unclear requests into clear next steps by asking the right questions and closing loops



2) Calendar + Priority Management

Own scheduling and protect Ishita’s focus time

Build daily/weekly clarity: what matters now, what can wait, what needs escalation

Prepare Ishita for meetings with context, agendas, and “what decision is needed”



3) Design Project Support (Studio Ops for Creative Work)

Track project milestones, approvals, open decisions, and dependencies across multiple projects

Maintain simple project trackers: timelines, action items, who owns what, and due dates

Coordinate with clients, vendors, contractors, and internal team to keep projects moving

Capture meeting notes, decisions, and action lists—and drive follow-through to completion



4) Organization + Systems Implementation

Create repeatable systems: templates, checklists, SOPs, naming conventions, file structure

Improve how the studio runs: fewer dropped balls, less back-and-forth, faster execution

Translate Ishita’s ideas into structured plans that others can implement



5) Pressure Handling + Rapid Problem Solving

Stay calm when something changes last minute (because it will)

Anticipate risks, surface constraints early, and present options (Plan A/B/C)

Communicate issues clearly with impacts, timelines, and recommended next steps





You’ll Thrive Here If You Are

Elite communicator. Clear writing, sharp summaries, confident tone. You love closing loops.

An exceptional organizer. You create clarity quickly and keep many moving pieces synchronized.

Calm under pressure. You don’t spiral when things change—you prioritize and execute.

A driver (high-D). You take initiative, make decisions, push progress, and hate dropped balls.

A fast learner. Tools, design vocabulary, and new workflows don’t intimidate you.

Process-minded. You don’t just survive chaos—you build systems that prevent it next time.



Qualifications

- 2+ years in an Executive Assistant, Operations Assistant, Project Coordinator, Producer, or similar role supporting a senior leader

- Strong proficiency with Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs)

- Excellent written communication and professional judgment

- Comfortable learning and operating inside tools like Notion / Asana / ClickUp / Trello (any is fine)

- Ability to flex occasionally for time-sensitive deadlines (rare, but part of the job)





Nice to Have (Not Required)

Experience in interiors, design studios, architecture firms, creative agencies, or construction-adjacent environments

Familiarity with procurement workflows, vendor coordination, timelines, and approvals

Comfort with basic docs/slides and keeping shared drives organized





What Success Looks Like (30/60/90)



30 Days

Inbox and calendar are stabilized: organized, responsive, and prioritized

A simple system exists for action items, follow-ups, and meeting notes

Ishita is noticeably less reactive day-to-day because you’ve created structure



60 Days

Project trackers are consistently up to date (milestones, approvals, open decisions)

Communication threads are clean and proactive (fewer “just checking in” loops)

Weekly cadence is running smoothly: status updates, blockers, and decisions are visible



90 Days

Ishita’s schedule and focus time feel protected and intentional

Dropped-ball rate is near zero

You’re proactively improving systems and preventing problems before they happen





Compensation & Growth

Competitive salary (shared in later stages; commensurate with experience and location)

Growth path: EA ? Senior EA / Operations Lead





How to Apply (Required)



Please submit all of the following:

1) Resume (PDF)

2) Loom Video (Required — 4–6 minutes max)



Record one Loom (screen-share on). Include a link to the video in your application.

We’re evaluating: clarity, prioritization, tone, judgment, and how you create structure fast.



In your Loom, answer all 5 prompts below:



Prompt 1: Inbox Triage + Drafting

“You open Ishita’s inbox and there are 35 unread
s from clients, vendors, and internal team. Walk us through exactly how you would triage it in the first 30 minutes, and draft responses (on screen) to any two
s:

- one client
 needing an update + reassurance

- one vendor
 with missing info or a delay



Show your folder/label system, what you escalate, and what you close out immediately.”



Prompt 2: Chaos ? Plan

“Describe a time you walked into a messy situation (unclear owner, shifting priorities, moving pieces). Tell the story in 60–90 seconds, then explain the framework you used to stabilize it: what you clarified first, what you documented, who you aligned, and how you tracked owners + deadlines.”



Prompt 3: Design Project Coordination Scenario

“Scenario: It’s Tuesday. Ishita has a concept presentation Friday. A vendor says a key lighting option is backordered, the client is asking for ‘one more revision,’ and a contractor needs dimensions for a built-in by end of day.

Create a quick ‘command plan’ for the next 48 hours:

- priorities ranked (1–5)

- who you’ll contact and in what order

- Plan A/B/C for the lighting issue

- the exact update you’ll send to Ishita (tight bullets)

Bonus: show what tool you’d put this in.”



Prompt 4: Writing Test (Live)

“Live on Loom, draft a short client update
 (6–10 sentences) that covers: status, what’s done, what’s next, what you need from them, and the next milestone. Assume the client is anxious—keep it warm, confident, and direct. Then rewrite it as an ‘executive brief’ (bullets, 8 lines max).”



Prompt 5: Systems + Follow-Through

“Show your personal system for ensuring nothing drops: follow-ups, reminders, tracking decisions, and dependencies. If you can, screen-share a template you’ve created (sanitized). If not, build one live in a doc.”



3) (Optional, but encouraged)

A sanitized example of a tracker, SOP, or template you’ve used to run projects or follow-ups (Doc/Notion/Sheet/PDF).



Important: We won’t move forward without a Loom. This role lives and dies by communication clarity and follow-through.

title: SEO Expert (AEO & AIO Search Optimization Specialist)
description:
Position Type: Part-time (with opportunity to transition into Full-time)



-------------

### Position Overview



We are seeking an experienced SEO Expert with hands-on expertise in Webflow, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), and AI Optimization (AIO) to strengthen our digital growth efforts. This role will focus on maximizing visibility across traditional search engines, AI-powered search experiences, and answer-based platforms while ensuring our Webflow websites are fully optimized for performance, discoverability, and conversions.



-------

### Key Responsibilities



- Develop and execute SEO strategies to increase organic traffic, rankings, and lead generation

- Implement **AEO strategies** for featured snippets, FAQs, voice search, and answer-based search experiences

- Implement **AIO strategies** to improve content visibility across AI-powered search platforms and conversational interfaces

- Manage and optimize SEO implementation within **Webflow** environments

- Conduct keyword research, topic clustering, search intent analysis, and competitor research

- Optimize on-page elements including:

    - Meta titles and descriptions

    - URL structures

    - Heading hierarchy

    - Internal linking

    - Content structure

- Configure and improve technical SEO elements within Webflow, including:

    - Schema markup

    - Sitemap optimization

    - Redirect management

    - Site speed optimization

    - Mobile responsiveness

    - Core Web Vitals improvements

- Collaborate with content, design, and development teams to create SEO-driven content strategies

- Monitor search algorithm updates and emerging AI search trends

- Track, analyze, and report SEO performance metrics

- Perform regular website audits and recommend technical and content improvements



-------

### Required Qualifications



- 3–5+ years of SEO experience with measurable results

- Strong hands-on experience managing and optimizing **Webflow websites**

- Proven experience with **Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)** and **AI Optimization (AIO)** strategies

- Strong understanding of:

    - Technical SEO

    - Semantic SEO

    - Structured data

    - Search intent optimization

    - Entity-based search

- Experience using:

    - Google Analytics

    - Google Search Console

    - Ahrefs

    - SEMrush

    - Screaming Frog or equivalent SEO tools

- Experience implementing schema markup and structured data

- Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills



-------

### Preferred Qualifications



- Experience with AI-assisted content workflows and AI search ecosystems

- Familiarity with marketing automation tools and integrations

- Basic HTML/CSS knowledge

- Experience in SaaS, technology, agency, or fast-paced digital environments



-------

### Success Metrics



Success in this role may be measured through:

- Increased organic traffic growth

- Improved keyword rankings

- Increased featured snippets and answer-engine visibility

- Improved AI-generated search visibility

- Better Core Web Vitals and technical SEO performance

- Higher conversion rates from organic channels



-------------

### How to Apply



This role is open for **part-time candidates, with the opportunity to transition into a full-time position based on performance and business needs.**



Send your application to 
 with the subject line *"SEO Expert – AEO/AIO Application – [Your Name]"*.

title: Business Operations Assistant – Sales, Marketing, Accounts & Project Admin
description:
We are an Australian business in the window, door, and automation industry looking for a full-time Business Operations Assistant to support the founder and team across day-to-day business admin, sales support, marketing support, project admin, procurement admin, and basic accounts admin.



This is not a basic VA role.



We need someone organised, resourceful, systems-savvy, and able to help take backend work off the founder and team. You will be helping keep the business organised, following up tasks, updating systems, preparing admin documents, assisting with purchase orders, supporting marketing tasks, and helping make sure important work does not fall through the cracks.



This role suits someone who is practical, detail-oriented, proactive, and able to figure things out without needing step-by-step instructions for every task.



Key Responsibilities



1. Sales Admin & CRM Support

You will help keep our sales process organised and moving.



Tasks may include:



- updating HubSpot CRM

- entering new leads and enquiries

- updating contacts, companies, deals, notes, and tasks

- setting follow-up reminders

- drafting follow-up
s

- tracking quotes and proposals

- flagging stale leads or missed follow-ups

helping prepare weekly sales activity summaries

- keeping sales records clean and up to date



2. Marketing Support



You will assist with practical marketing and content support.



Tasks may include:



- creating simple marketing materials in Canva

- preparing flyers, brochures, presentations, and social media graphics

- organising project photos and marketing assets

- helping create basic content drafts using AI tools

- formatting case studies and project examples

- maintaining marketing folders and collateral

- supporting
 marketing and LinkedIn/admin tasks

- keeping marketing material clean, organised, and on-brand



You do not need to be a high-level graphic designer, but you must be comfortable creating clean, professional-looking materials.



3. Project Admin Support



You will assist with backend project admin so jobs stay organised.



Tasks may include:



- preparing and tracking purchase orders

updating project trackers

- organising project folders and documents

- following up suppliers for pricing, lead times, and delivery updates

- tracking procurement items and supplier responses

- assisting with project handover documents

- organising drawings, quotes, invoices, and project correspondence 

- helping maintain project-related records in Notion, Google Drive, or other systems

- chasing missing information from suppliers, subcontractors, or internal tea
mbers

- helping make sure project admin tasks are completed on time



You will not be expected to make technical project decisions, but you must be able to keep records organised and follow up properly.



4. Procurement Admin



You will support purchasing and supplier coordination.



Tasks may include:



- preparing purchase order drafts

checking supplier details

- tracking supplier quotes and lead times

- following up orders

- updating procurement registers

- organising supplier documents and price lists

- checking whether required information is missing

- helping keep procurement files and trackers current

- Final approval of purchases will remain with the business owner or authorised tea
mber.



5. Accounts Admin Support



You will assist with basic accounts admin and record keeping.



Tasks may include:



- supporting Xero admin

- organising receipts, invoices, and supplier bills

- preparing payment/invoice summaries

- tracking overdue invoices or payment follow-ups

- organising accounts documents

- helping keep financial records tidy

- assisting with basic reporting or admin preparation



You will not have payment authority. Final payment approvals and financial decisions remain with the founder.



6. General Business Admin & Systems Support



You will help keep the business systems organised.



Tasks may include:



- maintaining Notion pages and SOPs

- organising Google Drive folders and files

- preparing meeting notes and action lists

- updating task trackers

- formatting documents

- drafting
s

- creating checklists and templates

- helping improve internal workflows

- using AI tools to speed up admin and content tasks

- documenting repeatable processes



Required Skills



The right person must have:



- strong written and spoken English

- excellent organisation and attention to detail

- experience with Google Workspace

- experience with Canva

- experience with HubSpot or another CRM

- experience with Xero or accounting/admin systems

- confidence using ChatGPT / AI tools

- ability to work independently

- ability to figure things out before asking for help

- strong follow-through

- good communication

- calm and reliable working style

- ability to handle multiple tasks without getting overwhelmed



Highly Regarded Experience



Experience in any of the following is highly regarded:



- working with an Australian, US, UK, or NZ business

- construction, trades, property, real estate, - building services, or service-based business admin

- project admin or procurement admin

- purchase order preparation

- supplier follow-up

- CRM management

- Xero/accounts admin

- Notion setup or SOP organisation

supporting a founder or small business owner.



Industry experience is helpful but not mandatory. We care more about your ability to stay organised, follow up, use systems, and take ownership.



Tools We Use



You should be comfortable using or learning:



- HubSpot

- Notion

- Xero

- Canva

- Google Workspace

- Google Drive

- Google Sheets

- ChatGPT / AI tools

 and task management systems



You do not need to know every tool perfectly from day one, but you must be able to learn quickly and figure things out independently.



Work Hours



This is a full-time remote role.

You must have strong overlap with Australian business hours, Monday to Friday.



Important



This role does not suit someone who needs to be spoon-fed every task.



We are looking for someone who can:



- follow instructions

- ask smart questions

- use common sense

- research and figure things out

- keep tasks moving

- update systems properly

- communicate clearly when something is blocked

- take ownership of recurring admin work



If you are proactive, organised, systems-savvy, and enjoy helping a growing business run better, this role may be a good fit.

Export quickly

Volume

Hooks

Marketing thinking

Speed

Duplication

Testing angles

Viral potential

Communication

 with UK-based colleagues and stakeholders

title: Demand Planner & Inventory Analyst
description:
Your job is to make sure the right stock is in the right place at the right time - across UK and US - for a fast-growing jewellery brand.



Job Opportunity: Demand Planner & Inventory Analyst



We are D.LOUISE, one of the UK’s fastest-growing women’s jewellery brands, with a rapidly expanding footprint in the US. We sell direct-to-consumer through Shopify and run UK and US 3PLs. We move fast, we run lean, and we use AI to multiply what a small team can do.



We’re hiring a Demand Planner & Inventory Analyst to own one of the most important jobs in our business: making sure we have the right stock in the right warehouse at the right time, without tying up cash in overbuys or losing sales to stockouts.



This is a deep, analytical, numbers-heavy role. You will live inside our WSSI, our PO process, our supplier relationships, and our stock dashboards. You are the person who flags a re-buy three weeks before anyone else notices we’re short. You are the person who spots that the US warehouse is overstocked on a SKU that the UK is selling out of, and proposes the transfer.



This role also requires you to be AI-first — not curious about AI, but already using it every day to do more, faster, and better. If AI isn’t already changing how you work, this role isn’t for you.





Key Responsibilities



Inventory & Demand Planning

• Own and maintain the WSSI/MSSI — weekly stock, sales and intake — across UK and US.

• Forecast demand by SKU and channel. Flag re-buy risks early. Pressure-test supplier lead times.

• Balance stock between UK and US warehouses to avoid overstock in one market while stocking out in another.

• Minimise overbuys on slow lines, maximise availability on core lines, and keep buys aligned to the commercial budget and cash-flow forecast.



Purchase Orders & Supplier Coordination

• Own the PO process end-to-end — raise, track, chase, confirm receipt against the WSSI.

• Maintain positive day-to-day relationships with suppliers and freight forwarders. Confirm terms, lead times, and shipment status.

• Coordinate inbound freight from suppliers into UK and US 3PLs — importation, customs documentation, and clearance.



Reporting & Stock Visibility

• Build and maintain dashboards that surface stock health — cover, sell-through, ageing, intake vs forecast — visible to the leadership team.

• Surface weekly insights: what’s at risk, what’s overstocked, what to re-buy, what to mark down.

• Partner with finance on landed cost, margin, and cash-flow impact of buying decisions.



You’re not a fit for this role if

• You haven’t owned a WSSI/MSSI before in a real working business.

• You haven’t worked in DTC e-commerce or retail.

• You’re not strong in Excel / Google Sheets at a model-building level (pivots, lookups, advanced formulas, scenario modelling).

• You see AI as a “nice to have” rather than core to how you work.



You’re a fit if

• 3+ years in demand planning, inventory analysis, merchandise planning, or buying — specifically in DTC e-commerce, retail, or fashion.

• Hands-on experience with WSSI/MSSI to manage and report on stock-on-hand positioning.

• Strong analytical thinker. You procure and treat data efficiently. Excel and Google Sheets are second nature — pivots, lookups, advanced formulas, scenario modelling. Bonus if you’ve worked with Looker, BigQuery, or ERP/inventory tools.

• Sharp problem-solving instincts. You spot patterns and anomalies in data before anyone tells you to look.

• Understanding of P&L structures — COGS, direct costs — and how product margins flow to the bottom line.

• Understanding of e-commerce marketing activity and how it impacts demand (campaigns, promos, BFCM, paid spikes).

• AI-first. You use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, n8n, automations) daily to make yourself more productive. You can show us examples.

• Excellent written English. You’ll be communicating with UK / US teams and suppliers in writing, often async.

• Comfortable in a small, fast-moving team. You can take on adjacent work when needed without losing focus on your core role.



How to Apply

Applications that don’t follow these instructions will not be reviewed. We’re looking for people who read carefully, follow instructions precisely, and care about detail. The application itself is your first test.



1. Put the word “Gold Jewellery” in the subject line of your application.

If you don’t include this word, your application will be rejected without being read. This is how we know you actually read this job spec.



2. Record a 2-5 minute Loom video answering these three questions:

1. Walk us through a WSSI you’ve owned. What did it look like, and what did you do with it?

2. Tell us about one AI tool or workflow you use every day, and how it has changed your work.

3. Walk us through your screen — show us a recent Excel or Google Sheets model you built. 

Talk us through what it does.

Don’t over-produce it. We’re looking at how you think and communicate, not your video editing.

3. Attach your CV and a one-paragraph summary of why you’re interested in this role specifically.



If you pass the first round you will move onto a paid task.

Creative Strategist & Production Coordinator (E-commerce)



We’re hiring a Creative Strategist & Production Coordinator to help us scale our paid creative output for Meta.



This role sits between creative strategy and execution. You will research winning ad concepts, identify ideas worth testing for our brand, adapt and write scripts, prepare voiceover and soundtrack drafts, create clear briefs for editors, and coordinate creator content production.



We’re looking for someone with strong creative taste, Meta ad understanding, good written English, and solid execution skills.



What You’ll Own



1. Creative Research & Strategy Support



You will research competitor and adjacent-brand ads, identify concepts and scripts that could work for our brand, and help build a clear pipeline of ideas worth testing. You should be able to recognize strong hooks, understand what makes an ad compelling, and think in terms of “same but different” rather than just copying what already exists.



2. Script Development



You will adapt winning concepts to our brand, write new scripts when needed, and create multiple hook variations for each concept. You should understand how to write for paid social, especially Meta, and know the difference between writing something that sounds good and writing something that is designed to convert.



3. Creative Assembly & Briefing



You will generate voiceovers, pair them with music, and assemble rough audio drafts that can be used for production. You will also turn concepts into clear, structured Notion briefs for editors, including line-by-line shot guidance, references, and relevant asset links. You should have enough editing sense to understand rhythm, pacing, and how a creative should come together.



4. Creator Coordination



You will help source creators for content batches following our SOPs, support outreach and follow-up, keep communication organized, and make sure deliverables are collected and stored properly. You should be comfortable coordinating moving parts, tracking progress, and helping maintain a reliable flow of fresh creator content.



Expected Deliverables :



The role is designed to support a consistent paid creative testing pipeline by following SOPs. The expected output includes:



- Consistent production of new video briefs (8 per month to start)

- Script development, voiceover generation, ongoing research

- 1 creator batch every 1–2 months, typically around 5 creators

- Creative Strategy research 



What We’re Looking For



You are likely a strong fit if you have experience working on Meta creatives for ecommerce brands and understand how paid social ads are structured to perform.



You should have:



- Experience with Meta /
 ad creatives

- strong understanding of hooks, angles, and direct-response creative

- good written English

- the ability to identify winning concepts and adapt them to a brand

- basic to strong editing skills

- Experience in following SOPs

- a good sense of rhythm, pacing, and creative flow

- strong organization and attention to detail

- the ability to turn ideas into clean, actionable briefs

- experience in DTC / ecommerce



Nice to Have



experience using DaVinci Resolve

experience with 11Labs or other voiceover tools

experience working with UGC creators / influencer coordination

experience building briefs in Notion



Payment



This role will start part-time (4 days a week, Monday to Thursday) moving toward full-time.

Compensation will depend on experience and proof of past results, but our initial target range is around $10/hour - $1500/month to start, with room to grow for the right person as results and responsibilities expand.



How to Apply



Please include:

a short note on your experience with Meta ad creatives

examples of ecommerce creative work you’ve been involved in

any relevant scriptwriting, creative strategy, editing, or briefing experience

tools you’ve used (for example: DaVinci, 11Labs, Notion, etc.)

title: Head of Operations
description:
We are excited to announce a senior opportunity to join our rapidly growing women’s jewellery brand, D.LOUISE. We are one of the UK’s fastest-growing companies with an expanding footprint in the US and ambitious plans for international growth.



We’re looking for a hands-on Head of Operations to serve as the CEO’s right hand and second-in-command — the operational backbone of the business and the connective tissue between product, marketing, e-commerce, logistics, CX and finance. You will own the operating rhythm end-to-end, run our inbound and outbound shipping across UK and US, and hold every function accountable to what they said they’d do.



The ideal candidate isn’t a corporate “process admin” — you’re a builder-operator: someone who thrives in fast-moving environments, builds systems from the ground up, and treats the business like it’s your own.



This role also requires someone who is genuinely AI-first — not curious about AI, but already using it every day to multiply their own output and their team’s. If that isn’t you, this role isn’t for you.



Key Responsibilities



Operating Rhythm & Execution

• Own the operating rhythm: weekly trade, monthly planning, quarterly reviews, launch readiness — with the project management system as the single source of truth.

• Hold function leaders accountable to commitments. Chase politely, firmly, and on time.

• Give the CEO early-warning visibility on what’s on track, what’s at risk, and what needs a decision — by 6am UAE time, without messaging anyone.



Logistics, Stock & CX

• Own UK and US 3PLs as key accounts — SLAs, cost per order, dispatch performance — plus inbound freight, landed cost, customs, and cross-border compliance.

• Own a single source of truth for stock across Shopify, 3PLs, and in-transit inventory; coordinate UK?US transfers; partner with merchandising and finance on forecasting and margin.

• Oversee the CX function and its KPIs — someone runs the day-to-day; you hold them accountable, and make sure issues feed back into product, logistics and ops.



AI, Systems & Reporting

• Drive AI and automation adoption across operations — finding leverage, building workflows, replacing manual work.

• Build SOPs and systems that work without constant oversight; recommend hires before capacity breaks.

• Build dashboards that surface what matters — trade, stock, 3PL SLAs, CX, launch status, P&L — so the CEO can ask one question and get an answer with the receipts.



You’re not a fit for this role if

• You haven’t worked at a DTC e-commerce company.

• You haven’t managed 3PL or vendor networks.

• You haven’t built systems and SOPs from scratch.

You’re a fit if

• 5–10+ years in operations, logistics, or supply chain, specifically in DTC/e-commerce brands in the $10M–$50M revenue range.

• Proven track record of building scalable systems (dashboards, SOPs, reporting) — not just maintaining corporate processes.

• Hands-on experience managing international supply chains (China, US, EU), 3PLs, and vendors.

• Strong financial acumen: margins, landed costs, forecasting, and cost optimisation.

• Builder mindset. You roll up your sleeves, fix what’s broken, then scale it.

• Comfort with chaos and urgency — making fast decisions, firefighting, and then creating structure.

• Experience leading lean teams (3–15 people) in start-up or scale-up environments.

• AI-first. Not “I’ve used ChatGPT.” You’ve built workflows, agents, or automations that have meaningfully replaced manual work.

• Proficiency with tools like Shopify, Amazon, Notion, Slack, n8n, AI tools, and reporting dashboards (Google Sheets / Looker Studio / ERP).

• Excellent communication with internal teams and external partners across geographies.

• Flexibility to travel internationally (China, US, EU) a few times per year.



How to Apply



This is a senior, builder-operator role — so the application is itself part of the assessment. We want to see how you think, how you communicate, and how you operate before we sit down with you. We’re not interested in polished CVs alone.



To apply, send us three things:



1. The Task — a written response (no longer than 1,000 words)

Imagine you’ve been Head of Operations at D.LOUISE for 60 days. Prepare a written response covering:



• Your assessment of the three biggest operational risks you’d expect to find in a business like ours (educated guesses are fine — we want to see your operator instincts).

• A 90-day plan: what you’d prioritise, in what order, and why.

• One specific AI/automation workflow you’d build inside the first 60 days — with a rough architecture: which tools, what it replaces, what it costs.

• Three KPIs you’d put on the CEO’s dashboard from day one, and why.

• One thing you’d ask the CEO to stop doing.



Full creative freedom on format — Google Doc, Notion page, Loom walkthrough, whatever you’d naturally produce. We care more about how you think than how it looks.



2. A 2-5 minute Loom video

Walk us though whatever project management system you use and how you would set it up for us



3. Your CV and a short note

One paragraph on why this role specifically. No cover letter, no long essays.



How we’ll handle applications

• We review every application that follows the instructions. We don’t review applications that don’t.

• Shortlisted candidates will hear from us within 7 days.

• From there: a screening call, a deep-dive interview with the CEO, and a final stage with the leadership team. We aim to make an offer within 2–3 weeks of first contact.

title: Healthcare Virtual Assistant that is Transparent
description:
APPLICATION PROCESS 



-
 us your resume in Pdf format only. Include all of the jobs you've worked at and the month + year. Do not leave anything off. There should be no gaps in your resume with no explanations. Include your compensation for all jobs. (not hourly, only total compensation for the period of time you workd or annual compensation)

-
 us a 60-second video of yourself answering the following question: 

"What are the 3 most important things that the company you work for must do to show you that they care about you? For example, if they don’t give me these 3 things then that means they don’t care about me." The video Cannot exceed 60 seconds, or you will automatically be disqualified.

- Important: do not private message us. Failure to follow the above instructions will result in automatic disqualifications.



ABOUT OUR COMPANY



Achieve Integrative Health is the #1 rated Acupuncture & Wellness Clinic in the United States. Our Mission is to help people restore their body’s God given ability to heal itself so that they can do what they love.



WHY JOIN US



We Pursue Excellence — Always.

- At our company, excellence is not optional; it’s our culture. Every tea
mber is expected to give their best in attitude, discipline, and performance. When you join us, you’ll work with colleagues who are serious about growth, responsibility, and achieving world-class results.



Achieve Your Goals with Our Support.

- We provide everything you need to succeed—training, resources, and mentorship—so you can achieve your professional, financial, and personal goals. All we ask is your commitment to achieving your own goals.



Peaceful and Joyful Team Environment.

- We protect our culture of peace and joy through clear rules, discipline, and shared values. Our tea
mbers support each other, speak honestly, and always act with integrity. We do not tolerate gossip, entitlement, laziness, or negativity—only mutual respect, teamwork, and growth.



Be Highly Rewarded for Your Excellence.

- We believe that when you perform with excellence and passion, financial success follows naturally. While typical VAs in Indonesia and the Philippines must accumulate 5 years VA experience to earn around $5–$7 USD/hour, our entry-level virtual assistants start at $5/hour, with clear pathways to higher income as you grow and produce more results.  Our HVAs earn on average $14,560- $18,720 annually.



BENEFITS & COMPENSATION



- Competitive Pay: $5–$12 USD/hour (graveyard shift only).

- Growth Without Limits: Your growth depends only on your performance and results. Top performers can even become business partners.

- Employee Benefits: Paid-time off, premiu
dical insurance, and Employee Savings Matching Program for qualified tea
mbers.

- Work from Home: Eliminate long commutes and enjoy more time for family and personal life.

- Wellness Support: Complimentary virtual health services for you and your family—because your well-being matters.



JOB RESPONSIBILITIES



- Contact and qualify leads through calls,
s, and other communication channels.

- Receive and handle incoming calls from potential patients, answer questions, and convert them into new patients.

- Ensure every patient receives five-star service and feels valued.

- Follow up with patients using our Care System to maintain satisfaction and loyalty.

- Collect and share patient success stories during daily company meetings.

- Manage patient check-in and check-out procedures accurately.

- Verify insurance benefits and maintain detailed records.

- Take on additional responsibilities based on your professional strengths.



CHARACTER REQUIREMENTS & QUALIFICATIONS 



- We only welcome tea
mbers who want to help people and perform with excellence. If you truly care about others and strive to do your best every day, you’ll fit perfectly into our team.

- You must have a genuine heart to serve. We work to transform lives through better health. If your main focus is money, this is not the right team for you.

- You must speak fluent English. Your communication must be clear and easily understood over the phone—no repetitions, no confusion.

- You must be organized and efficient. Our environment is fast-paced. You’ll handle multiple tasks daily with accuracy and attention to detail. If you prefer to do very few tasks, this role won’t suit you. 

- You must follow instructions precisely. We value consistency and reliability. If you dislike reading procedures or following directions, you will hate or team.

- You must value results, not just effort. We reward performance, not activity. Your pay is tied directly to your results—your key performance indicators, metrics, and quotas—not how busy you appear to be.

- You must be honest and have integrity. One act of dishonesty leads to immediate termination. We trust one another completely.

- You must want to earn your rewards. We believe compensation should reflect results, not background or potential. If you want automatic pay raises without proven performance, you will hate our team.

- whether you have experience or not, does not matter.  We are only looking for people who have integrity.  If you are a person who likes to go on social media or online to talk behind people's back, you will definitely hate our team.  



WORKSTATION REQUIREMENTS

- You must have a separate quiet room to work in. You can not have your children or anybody else in the room that you work as your screen will be displaying confidential information, no exceptions.

- There can not be any background noise in your room when you are making phone calls.

- You will be required to provide photos of your workspace

- We will also randomly ask you to show your workspace via your webcam, and if you are caught lying you will be fired immediately.



COMPUTER & INTERNET REQUIREMENTS



- Fast and reliable wired internet connection of not less than 100 Mbps

- Secondary and Tertiary Back up Internet of not less than 10 Mbps

- At least one Power Station Backup

- Dual Monitor

- Intel Core i5, Apple CPUs or higher Operating System with at least 8gb ram (no AMD CPUs)

- Excellent quality headset with microphone, and a working webcam



WORK SCHEDULE OPTIONS:



- Full-time: U.S. Central Standard Time (Graveyard Shifts in Philippines/Indonesia) = roughly around 8am to 6pm cst. (2 hr lunch break)

- Part-time: 13:00-18:30 CST mon-fri

Familiarity with Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and emerging platforms

title: WordPress Technical Lead - Launch, QA & Maintenance (Long-Term, Brisbane Agency)
description:
WordPress Technical Lead - Launch, QA & Maintenance (Long-Term, Brisbane Agency)

About us

We're a small, family-run web design agency based in Brisbane, Australia. We build WordPress sites for local businesses - mostly using Elementor Pro, hosted on SiteGround. We're growing, and we're looking for one reliable, genuinely skilled person to take ownership of the technical side of our projects so we can focus on bringing in new work.

This is not a data-entry or general VA role. We need a real WordPress developer who knows the platform deeply and can be trusted to work inside our systems without hand-holding.

We're after a long-term relationship, not a one-off job. If this works well, there's a clear path to ongoing retainer work and potentially full-time - we'd much rather find one great person and keep them than constantly rehire.

What you'll do

You'll be our second set of expert eyes and our go-to technical person. Our builds are done by a separate developer - your job is to review, polish, launch and maintain. Day to day, that means:



Reviewing completed builds before they go live - checking every page, link and element is working and looks 100% right

Taking sites live properly, with no broken links, missing redirects or surprises

Setting up and managing SiteGround hosting and making sure everything runs cleanly

Checking all plugins are installed, configured and working correctly

Handling technical SEO - schema markup, meta setup, indexing, site health

Adding internal and external links where it helps the site

Planning and running URL migrations for redesign projects - mapping old URLs to new ones and setting up 301 redirects so we don't lose traffic or rankings

Being the person we can contact when something breaks - diagnosing and fixing issues across the WordPress / Elementor / SiteGround stack

As we grow, there may also be opportunity to take on full site builds yourself - so if you're a strong builder as well as a reviewer, tell us



Who you are



Strong, proven experience building and maintaining WordPress sites

Confident with Elementor Pro specifically

Comfortable working inside SiteGround (not just wp-admin) - hosting, staging, server-level basics

You understand technical SEO and schema, and can explain what you're doing in plain English

You've done website migrations before and understand how to protect traffic and rankings

Reliable, honest about timelines, and good at communicating - if something's wrong, you tell us early

Available during some overlap with Brisbane business hours (AEST) for when issues come up



The arrangement



We'll start hourly on a small trial project or two so we can both see if it's a good fit

From there, we move to ongoing work - a monthly block of hours for launches and support, plus project work as it comes

This starts at around 10-15 hours a week, but that's a starting point, not a cap. We're growing, and for the right person there's genuine scope for the hours to increase over time - potentially toward full-time. If you can build sites as well as review them, that's exactly the kind of person we want to grow with

Rate is $9/hr USD to start, with room to grow as the role does. We're not chasing the cheapest option - we'd rather pay fairly for someone we can trust and keep

You'll have your own secure logins (we use a password manager) and we'll ask you to sign a simple NDA, since you'll have access to our clients' sites



How to apply

We read every application properly, so please take a few minutes with yours. Generic copy-paste applications will be ignored.



Start your reply with the word MORETON so we know you've read this whole post.

In a short paragraph, tell us how you'd approach migrating a website to a new design without losing search traffic - specifically how you handle the old URLs.

Send links to 2-3 WordPress sites you've built or worked on, and briefly say what your role was on each.

Tell us your experience with SiteGround and Elementor Pro specifically.



Looking forward to meeting you.

mbers.

title: Growth & Business Development Lead
description:
The Company



Hire Anywhere helps UK businesses hire exceptional full-time remote talent in the Philippines through a proper headhunting model, not a freelancer marketplace.



We work closely with founders and growing businesses to help them build reliable overseas teams across operations, finance, marketing support, customer support, and executive support roles.



We’re a small founder-led business with strong delivery capability and happy clients. What we’re now focused on is building the demand side of the business properly.



The Opportunity



We’re looking for a commercially-minded growth and outbound operator to help us build a more consistent pipeline of qualified founder conversations.



This is not a traditional marketing role focused purely on content, paid ads, or social media management.



Instead, this role is about helping us:

- create qualified conversations with founders

- improve how we position the business

- build outbound systems and workflows

- refine messaging over time

- and help create a more repeatable demand engine



You’ll work closely with the founders and have meaningful ownership over shaping the outbound and growth side of the business.



What The Work Looks Like



Some of the work will involve:

- building target account lists

- writing outbound
 and LinkedIn messaging

- setting up outreach workflows and tooling

- helping improve LinkedIn visibility and positioning

- refining messaging based on response data

- coordinating qualified discovery calls

- tracking outreach and pipeline activity

- identifying ways to improve trust and conversion throughout the process



A large part of the challenge is trust and communication.



Many business owners are interested in overseas hiring, but are unsure whether:

- communication will work smoothly

- the quality will be high

- the process will feel professional

- overseas hiring is realistic for a smaller business



We’re looking for someone who understands how to bridge that gap through thoughtful outreach, positioning, and communication.



Who We Think Will Do Well In This Role



This role will likely suit someone who enjoys building things from scratch and is excited by the idea of helping shape the demand side of a growing business. We’re looking for someone who thinks commercially, communicates clearly, and is comfortable balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution.



You’re probably proactive, resourceful, and naturally inclined to improve systems, messaging, and processes rather than simply following instructions. You enjoy figuring things out, testing ideas, and refining what works over time, especially in founder-led or early-stage environments where there’s room to build.
