Partnering closely with these teams, this role assesses how each function uses the platform day-to-day, identifies opportunities to improve workflows, and designs and builds the automations, dashboards, and data structures needed to support efficient, data-driven operations. This role plays an important part in ensuring Salesforce is well configured, well used, and trusted as the single source of truth for customer, lead, and account information at Visualcare, and works with leadership across Sales and Customer Success to ensure platform investment translates into measurable business outcomes.



What are the requirements/credentials of an ideal candidate

• 4+ years working hands-on with Salesforce in a configuration, administration, or build capacity, ideally within a SaaS or technology-driven environment

• Demonstrated experience customising Salesforce — including building flows, process automations, validation rules, page layouts, custom objects, and approval processes

• Strong skills in designing and building dashboards and reports that support day-to-day operations and leadership decision-making across multiple business functions

• Experience partnering with Sales, Customer Success, and/or Customer Support teams to understand their workflows and translate operational needs into well-scoped Salesforce solutions

• Proven experience managing data quality in Salesforce — including data audits, deduplication, cleansing, and lead/contact enrichment

• Salesforce Administrator certification - Advanced Administrator, Service Cloud Consultant, Sales Cloud Consultant, or Platform App Builder certifications highly regarded

• Systems thinker with a strong workflow orientation — able to map how work flows across people, processes, and tools, and design solutions that hold up at scale

• High attention to detail with a disciplined approach to testing, documentation, and change management

• Excellent communication skills — able to partner with non-technical stakeholders, understand their workflows, and translate requirements into clear technical solutions

• Comfortable working across competing priorities from multiple business functions, with the ability to triage and sequence work transparently



?

Key Areas of Focus: 

* Workflow Discovery & Solution Design (30%)

-Partner with the Sales, Customer Success, and Help Desk teams to understand how each function uses Salesforce on a day-to-day basis.

-Identify workflow inefficiencies, operational gaps, and opportunities for process improvement across teams.

Recommend practical and scalable Salesforce solutions aligned with business needs and priorities.

Document both current-state and future-state workflows clearly for stakeholder alignment and ongoing business reference.



*Salesforce Configuration & Automation (35%)

-Build and configure Salesforce solutions including flows, automations, validation rules, custom objects, and page layouts.

Implement workflow enhancements that reduce manual processes and improve operational efficiency across Sales, Customer Success, and Help Desk functions.



-Apply structured testing and change management processes to ensure system stability and user adoption.

Maintain clear technical documentation for all configurations, automations, and system enhancements.



* Reporting & Dashboards (20%)

- Design and develop dashboards and reports that provide visibility into operational and team performance.

-Translate business and operational requirements into actionable reporting solutions such as pipeline tracking, customer health monitoring, ticket volume analysis, and resolution metrics.

-Ensure Salesforce data is properly structured to support accurate and meaningful reporting.

-Continuously optimize dashboards and reports based on evolving business priorities and KPIs.



*Data Cleansing & Enrichment (15%)

-Conduct regular Salesforce data audits to identify duplicates, inconsistencies, and data quality issues.

-Lead ongoing data cleansing initiatives to maintain Salesforce as a reliable source of truth.

-Enrich customer and lead records with relevant supporting data to improve targeting, segmentation, and reporting accuracy.

-Establish and maintain data quality standards, naming conventions, and governance processes to ensure long-term data integrity.



?

Success measures

• Salesforce workflows across Sales, Customer Success, and Help Desk are continuously improved, with regular delivery of scoped, well-tested enhancements

• Dashboards and reports are actively used by each business function and leadership for day-to-day decision-making

• Measurable improvements in operational efficiency (e.g. reduction in manual handling, improved resolution times, improved pipeline visibility) against baselines agreed with each team

• Salesforce data quality is consistently maintained — duplicates, gaps, and stale records reduced over time against agreed standards

• Customer and lead records are appropriately enriched to support segmentation, targeting, and reporting

• Strong, trusted working partnerships with the Sales, Customer Success, and Help Desk teams, with clear and transparent prioritisation of competing requests

title: Senior Video Editor — Performance Marketing
description:
Senior Video Editor — Performance Marketing



Company: Bublishing LLC / Ancient Remedies

Team: Performance Creative Team

Role Type: Full-time

Experience Required: Minimum 5 years



As a fast-growing natural health and wellness company, Ancient Remedies empowers people to take charge of their well-being through holistic medicine. We create beautifully crafted, practical books focusing on herbal remedies, food as medicine, and natural healing.



About the Role



We’re looking for a Senior Video Editor to join our Performance Marketing team and help create high-performing ads for a fast-scaling DTC health and wellness brand.



This is not a traditional video editing role. Can edit fast without becoming sloppy — speed and quality both matter here.



We need someone who understands that performance editing is not just about making videos look good — it’s about creating videos that hold attention, communicate clearly, build trust, and convert.



The ideal candidate is highly skilled in both traditional editing and AI-powered creative workflows. You should be comfortable working with AI-generated assets, organic footage, UGC-style content, and performance creative briefs. You should also understand pacing, retention, scroll-stopping hooks, pattern interrupts, and how editing decisions impact ad performance.



This person will be one of the strongest editors on the team and will work closely with the Lead Video Editor to improve creative quality, support the editing team, organize tools/assets, and help raise the overall standard of performance creative production.



Key Responsibilities



Performance Video Editing

• Edit high-converting ads for Meta, TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and other paid social platforms.

• Create performance-driven edits using a mix of AI-generated assets, UGC content, stock footage, motion graphics, voiceovers, and organic clips.

• Build strong openings, scroll-stopping hooks, pattern interrupts, and retention-focused sequences.

• Edit with a deep understanding of pacing, clarity, emotional pull, and conversion intent.

• Adapt edits based on creative strategy, ad performance, and feedback from Creative Strategists and Media Buyers.

• Produce multiple variations and iterations of winning ads quickly.



AI-Powered Editing & Creative Workflows

• Use AI tools to create, enhance, and iterate video assets.

• Work with tools such as VEO3, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, Seedance, Runway, Kling AI, and similar AI video/audio platforms.

• Create realistic AI-driven video outputs with attention to natural lip sync, voice matching, facial expressions, and believable human-like performances.

• Use prompting techniques to generate stronger AI assets, scenes, voices, characters, and visual sequences.

• Stay updated on the latest AI video tools, trends, workflows, and viral content formats.

• Help the team improve AI-assisted production speed and quality.



Creative Quality & Performance Standards

• Understand what makes an ad perform from an editing perspective.

• Analyze winning ads and apply creative insights into future edits.

• Identify what editing patterns, hooks, pacing, and formats are working.

• Help improve the quality and consistency of creative output across the team.

• Ensure videos are clear, polished, platform-native, and aligned with performance goals.

• Maintain fast turnaround times without sacrificing quality.



Team Support & Leadership

• Work closely with the Lead Video Editor to support the performance editing team.

• Help mentor, guide, and provide feedback to junior/mid-level editors when needed.

• Support quality control across edits before they move forward.

• Help organize tools, workflows, assets, references, and editing resources.

• Assist in improving editing processes, creative standards, and team efficiency.

• Act as a strong senior presence within the editing team.



Technical Requirements

• Minimum 5 years of professional video editing experience.

• Advanced proficiency in performance video editing for paid social ads.

• Strong experience with AI-powered video creation and editing workflows.

• Fast editing speed is required. This role requires someone who can move quickly, produce high-quality edits under tight timelines, and keep up with a high-volume performance marketing environment.

• Hands-on experience with tools such as:

  - VEO3

  - HeyGen

  - ElevenLabs

  - Seedance

  - Runway

  - Kling AI

  - or similar AI video/audio tools

• Strong understanding of:

  - AI prompting

  - natural lip sync

  - voice cloning

  - facial expressions

  - realistic AI human performances

  - AI-generated scenes and characters

• Strong understanding of:

  - retention editing

  - pacing

  - scroll-stopping hooks

  - pattern interrupts

  - engagement-driven storytelling

  - direct-response editing

• Experience editing short-form ads for:

  -

  - Instagram Reels

  - TikTok

  - YouTube Shorts

• Ability to work with both AI-generated and organic assets.

• Ability to deliver high-quality edits quickly and consistently.



Preferred Qualifications

• Experience working in performance marketing, DTC, e-commerce, supplements, health/wellness, or direct-response advertising.

• Experience managing, mentoring, or supporting a team of editors.

• Experience analyzing winning ads and translating insights into stronger edits.

• Strong understanding of creative testing and iteration.

• Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with Creative Strategists, Media Buyers, and other editors.

• Highly proactive, accountable, organized, and detail-oriented.

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-volume creative environment.

• Strong taste level and ability to balance performance with quality.



What Success Looks Like



A successful Senior Video Editor will:

• Consistently produce high-performing video ads.

• Improve the quality and speed of the editing team.

• Help turn creative briefs into polished, conversion-focused ads.

• Use AI tools effectively to increase production speed and creative possibilities.

• Understand why certain ads win and apply those learnings to future edits.

• Help the Lead Video Editor maintain high standards across the team.

• Contribute to a stronger, faster, and more scalable creative production system.



Who This Role Is For



This role is for someone who is not just a “good editor,” but someone who understands how editing directly impacts ad performance.



You should be someone who:

• Cares about results, not just aesthetics.

• Can move fast without being sloppy.

• Has strong creative instincts.

• Knows how to use AI tools effectively.

• Can take feedback without ego.

• Can help raise the standard of the team.

• Wants to be part of a high-performing creative engine.



Who This Role Is Not For



This role is not for someone who:

• Only edits long-form content or brand videos.

• Struggles to keep up with fast turnaround times or needs too much time to complete standard performance ad edits.

• Needs constant direction for every small decision.

• Is not comfortable using AI tools.

• Does not understand paid social ads.

• Prioritizes aesthetics over performance.

• Struggles with fast turnaround times.

• Avoids feedback or iteration.

• Cannot work in a high-volume creative environment.



Application Requirements



Please include:

• Portfolio or reel of relevant video editing work.

• Examples of short-form ads or paid social creatives.

Optional Trial Task

• Speed and communication

• Ability to follow a creative brief

title: AI Fashion Image Creator, E-commerce Product Photography (Gemini/Nano Banana)
description:
We're a growing e-commerce fashion brand. We turn basic supplier photos (AliExpress-style) into clean, premium-looking product images using AI image generation. We need someone who can do this consistently and who can judge their own work, not just press generate and send whatever comes out.



This is the most important sentence in this post: the skill we're hiring for is not "can you use the tool." It's "can you look at a generated image and know whether it looks premium or cheap, whether the model is consistent, whether the fabric pattern broke, whether a white dress disappears into a white background." If you can't see those things, this role is not for you.



Type: Part-time to start, ongoing for the right person



Salary: $4 an hour with possibility for increases over time.



What you'll do:

- Take supplier product photos plus a prompt template we provide

- Generate clean e-commerce image sets (hero, full body, back, detail) on a consistent studio background

- Keep the same model identity across every angle of a product

- Catch and fix problems: pattern misalignment, wrong colors, stiff poses, garments merging into the background

- Produce color variants of the same garment



You're a fit if:

- You have real experience with AI image generation (Midjourney, Gemini/Nano Banana, Seedream, Flux, etc.)

- You've done fashion or e-commerce product imagery before, show us

- You have an eye for what looks expensive vs. what looks like obvious AI junk

- You're meticulous and you re-do work that isn't right instead of sending it



You're NOT a fit if:

- Your plan is to paste our prompt, generate once, and send the first result

- You've never worked with fashion/clothing imagery

- You can't tell us why one generated image is better than another



Tools and growth: Once hired, you'll get access to a Claude account connected to Higgsfield so you can work efficiently and at volume. In the beginning the work will be mainly image generation. Over time the role can expand into handling the full product listing task.



To apply (applications that skip this are ignored):

- Link 3 to 5 examples of AI fashion/product images you've made

- One sentence: what's the most common mistake you see in AI-generated clothing images, and how do you fix it?



Shortlisted applicants will get a short unpaid test assignment so we can see your skill and approach before hiring.

title: Organic Content Lead / Director
description:
Ancient Remedies is a fast-moving natural health and wellness company on a mission to help people help themselves through holistic medicine. We make beautiful, practical books about herbal remedies, food as medicine, and natural health — and we sell thousands of books every day through paid channels.



Now we need to build the organic side of the brand.



Our organic presence is underbuilt. We have real products, real customers, and a mission people care about, but our social content does not yet reflect the trust, warmth, usefulness, and authority of the brand we are building. We do not want engagement bait. We do not want generic “Big Pharma doesn’t want you to know this” content. We want social content that makes people feel: this brand understands me, helps me, and can be trusted.



This role exists to own that shift.



You will lead the day-to-day organic social strategy across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts,
, and future channels. You will define what we post, why we post it, how it should feel, and how we improve. You’ll turn Ancient Remedies into a brand people are proud to follow, save, share, and buy from.



This is a high-ownership role. You will not be handed a perfect system. You will build the system. You’ll create content pillars, test formats, direct editors or creators, analyze performance, and raise the standard of everything we publish. The right person will have a rare mix of social taste, customer empathy, brand judgment, and speed.



What You’ll Own

• Define and execute the organic social strategy for Ancient Remedies.

• Build content that drives reach while increasing trust, authority, and brand warmth.

• Create repeatable content series around natural health, herbal remedies, food as medicine, seasonal wellness, and our books.

• Write hooks, scripts, captions, content briefs, and creative direction for short-form videos.

• Manage the content calendar and posting rhythm across key platforms.

• Work with editors, creators, or internal tea
mbers to produce content quickly.

• Identify what is working, what is not, and what we should test next.

• Improve the quality of our public-facing brand presence.

• Protect the brand from low-trust, legally risky, or off-mission content.

• Report clearly on performance, insights, and next steps.



Who We’re Looking For



We are looking for someone who understands social media at a deep, native level — but also understands that not all attention is good attention.



You should have strong taste. You can look at a post and explain why it works, why it feels cheap, why it builds trust, or why it damages the brand. You know the difference between content that gets views and content that creates real brand equity.



You should be genuinely interested in natural health, wellness, herbal remedies, food as medicine, or helping people take better care of themselves at home. You do not need to be a medical expert, but you need to care about the category and respect the customer.



You should be comfortable moving fast, testing often, and owning outcomes. This is not a role for someone who waits to be told exactly what to do. We want someone who brings ideas, notices problems, raises the bar, and takes responsibility.



You may be a great fit if you have:

• Experience growing or managing organic social accounts for a brand, creator, publisher, wellness company, education company, or consumer product.

• Strong instincts for short-form video, hooks, retention, storytelling, and platform-native content.

• A portfolio that shows real taste — not just trends, templates, or generic edits.

• The ability to direct editors, creators, or UGC talent.

• Comfort being scrappy: filming, briefing, scripting, posting, analyzing, and iterating.

• High standards for brand trust, accuracy, and customer perception.

• Clear communication and strong ownership.



This role is for someone who wants to build something meaningful, not just “run social.”



Please submit your application at zurl.to/fSmJ?source=CareerSite.

mbers.

 or recommending refunds/replacements based on SOPs.

---

title: WP Migration to Custom Site with CMS
description:
Web Developer / WordPress Migration Specialist Needed



WHEN YOU APPLY IF YOU DO NOT INCLUDE THESE QUESTIONS AS THE FIRST THING IN THE APPLICATION, IT WILL PROBABLY BE IGNORED OR OVERLOOKED



Provide 1-3 recommended stack for this project and why. I advise offering a low-mid-high stack. We have have very low traffic volume, maybe less than a thousand people a day at max. We have access to AWS/R2 Cloud storage for a CDN.

How you would preserve SEO during the migration.

How you would handle the blog/CMS functionality.

Examples of similar WordPress-to-custom or CMS migration projects you have participated in.

Whether you can match the current styling closely while improving the codebase.

How you would make the site easy for junior developers to maintain or edit and if the CMS is no code friendly.



We are looking for a skilled web developer or migration specialist to rebuild our current WordPress website into a custom, cleaner, faster, and easier-to-maintain website while retaining the same core features, styling, structure, and SEO value.



Our current site is:







The existing WordPress site is fairly simple, but it includes a blog/CMS system that we need to preserve or migrate into a better long-term CMS solution. The goal is not just to “move pages,” but to rebuild the site in a way that is faster, more secure, easier to manage, and future-proof for SEO and content publishing.



Project Overview



We want to migrate our current WordPress website to a custom-built website while retaining or improving the existing design, layout, CSS styling, page structure, calls-to-action, blog content, and SEO value.



The finished site should look and function the same or better than the current WordPress site. If the styling needs to be rewritten from scratch, that is acceptable as long as the final product closely matches or improves the current frontend appearance.



We are open to the right stack, but the final website must be easy to modify from either a junior developer perspective or a no-code/light-code perspective.



Key Requirements



The developer will be responsible for:



Rebuilding the current WordPress site into a custom website.

Preserving or improving the existing design, CSS styles, page layouts, and user experience.

Migrating the current blog/CMS content into a new CMS or content management workflow.

Preserving SEO value, URLs, metadata, heading structure, internal links, schema where applicable, and page performance.

Creating reusable templates/components for pages, CTAs, service areas, service pages, forms, and similar recurring elements.

Making it easy to add new pages (even if code required, we have developers), edit existing pages, and publish blog posts.

Ensuring the final system can be maintained by a junior developer or through a no-code/low-code CMS interface.

Improving website speed, structure, mobile responsiveness, and maintainability.

Setting up proper redirects if any URL structure changes.

Making sure the site remains clean, professional, and optimized for local appliance repair SEO.

CMS Requirement



The current WordPress site includes a blog, and we need to retain a CMS-style workflow.



We are open to recommendations, but the solution should allow us to easily:



Add blog posts.

Edit existing content.

Manage images.

Create service pages.

Reuse CTA blocks and page sections.

Maintain good SEO metadata.

Add new informational pages without requiring a senior developer.



Possible solutions could include a headless CMS, flat-file CMS, custom admin panel, Laravel-based CMS, Astro/Next.js with CMS integration, or another approach the developer can justify.



Preferred Final Result



The final site should be:



Fast.

SEO-friendly.

Secure.

Easy to update.

Mobile responsive.

Cleanly coded.

Template/component based.

Not dependent on bloated WordPress plugins.

Simple enough for junior developers or non-technical staff to maintain.

Important Notes



We do not want a generic redesign that loses the existing site structure or SEO value. The current site has existing content and styling that should be preserved, replicated, or improved intentionally.



We care heavily about long-term maintainability. The site should not become a custo
ss that only one developer understands. Code organization, documentation, and sensible structure matter.



Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate has experience with:



WordPress migrations.

Custom website development.

CMS architecture.

SEO-preserving migrations.

Responsive frontend development.

CSS/HTML/JavaScript.

Template/component-based development.

Local business/service company websites.

Page speed optimization.

Clean documentation.



Experience with Laravel, Vue, React, Astro, Next.js, Statamic, Craft CMS, Sanity, Strapi, Directus, Drupal or similar CMS/frontend stacks is a plus.



Expected deliverables include:



Fully rebuilt website.

Migrated pages and blog content.

CMS or editing workflow.

Reusable templates/components.

Preserved or improved styling.

Mobile-responsive layout.

SEO-preserving migration plan.

Redirects where needed.

Basic documentation for editing pages/posts.

Deployment assistance.



We are looking for someone who can think through the migration properly, not just copy the frontend. SEO, maintainability, and ease of editing are major priorities.
